description: Single source of truth for performance-gate thresholds and baseline compatibility. Local recipes and CI read this file; neither carries its own copy.

allocation_gate.threshold_note: SEP-21 integration rebases the measured admit/release cycle from the prior 3.000 to 8.000 allocations/op (three current-source 200000-op probes, all 8.000; see docs/release-checklist.md). This explicitly accepts a +5 allocation regression for the added governance state; it is not an improvement claim. The gate remains no-regression against the exact new baseline, without a cushion.
